body:
Founder real-time: 'can we build scipy and numpy into the standard language of PARENA?' Three small, composable packages mirroring numpy/scipy's own real layering: array (region-typed NDArray, every allocating fn takes explicit dest:Arena@Region -- the real divergence point from numpy's hidden global allocator), linalg (matmul/transpose/dot/inverse/solve), stats (mean/std/sum/min/max, deliberately narrow). Honest limitation flagged: real performance needs BLAS/LAPACK FFI, not a naive implementation -- not resolved here. Commit 7bf2449.

⚓ ☃
title: Stdlib design extended: numpy/scipy-equivalent (array/linalg/stats)
